edits.content: 4. No list contains the same `name` twice. Two cases. (a) The schema says the param takes several values ('comma-separated', or a `publisher` / `category` filter): write ONE entry with the values joined by commas and no spaces, e.g. `publisher`=`cnn.com,bbc.com`, `category`=`science,technology`. (b) The param takes a single value (`location`, `email`, `domain`, `country`, `sku`): make one call per value, each its own object, with shared qualifiers repeated. 'COVID-19 stats for Egypt and the United States' -> two `Coronavirus Smartable: GetStats` objects, one with `location`=`EG` and one with `location`=`US` (BAD: one object holding both `location` entries).

edits.target: 'General global news' with no topic takes a no-input feed (`Moka News: Recent 50`), not Search with an invented `q`.
edits.content: - OUTLET WITH NO ENDPOINT OF ITS OWN, AND QUALIFIER-RICH CLAUSES. 'Latest news stories from BBC' when no BBC endpoint is listed -> a tool whose input is a source id (`BizToc: News / Source`, required `source_id`=`bbc`). Never drop the clause and never swap in an unrelated feed. A clause with a count, sentiment, outlet or type ('5 positive movie news articles from the Hollywood Reporter') goes to the sibling whose optional list names those fields (`Kubric: The Comprehensive Movie News API: News`: `limit`=`5`, `sentiment`=`positive`, `source`=`Hollywood Reporter`), not to a no-parameter 'Trending' feed.

edits.target: only when that call's own clause states or implies it.
edits.content: - TOPIC AND OPTION WORDS FILL FILTERS. A topic word in a clause fills the tool's category/topic filter even on a 'sources' or 'list' tool: 'US-based science and technology news sources in English' on `NewsData: sources` -> category=`science,technology`, country=`us`, language=`en`. With no topic named and 'top' wording, use the listed option `top` ('top English-language news sources from the United States' -> category=`top`, country=`us`, language=`en`). Copy enum values from the option list printed in the schema. 'Federal' or 'active' qualifiers on a politicians tool fill `level_of_government` and `active`.

edits.target: - Stray trailing key after a one-param list: `"optional parameters": [{"name": "value", "value": "A"}], "optional parameters": []`. The empty list erased `value`=`A`.
When a sibling's name merely contains yours, re-read both descriptions.
edits.content: - SCOPE WORDS PICK THE SIBLING WITHIN ONE PROVIDER. Match the clause's scope and noun words to the words in the endpoint name: 'most recent developer articles from dev.to' -> `dev-to-api: Get all the latest articles`, but 'this month's top articles' -> `dev-to-api: Get the month's top articles`; 'a complete list of news categories from Moka News' -> `Moka News: categories`, not `Moka News: Sources List (New)`. Such no-input feeds take `[]` and `[]`, with no invented `limit` or `page`.

Do not shorten or 'fix' them. This includes non-Latin script (`Arabic news API: Youm7 - اليوم السابع`) and headings with extra colons (`Kubric: The Comprehensive Movie News API: Basic Search`): paste the whole `### ` line.
